cards.ex: The political instability of the era forms the historical backdrop to the novel's events.
cards.exUz: Davrning siyosiy beqarorligi romanning voqealari uchun tarixiy fonni tashkil qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealarning sodir bo'lishi uchun tarixiy sharoit yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: Those who champion peace and understanding will eventually inherit the earth.
cards.exUz: Tinchlik va tushunish tarafdorlari oxir-oqibat yerga vorislik qiladilar.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq muddatda g'alaba qozonmoq yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: After the devastating fire, the community worked hard to rise from the ashes.
cards.exUz: Vayronkor yong'indan so'ng, jamiyat koldan qayta tiklanish uchun qattiq ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatsizlikdan keyin qayta paydo bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The invention of the printing press was a watershed moment in the history of communication.
cards.exUz: Bosmaxonaning ixtirosi aloqa tarixida burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarishga olib keladigan voqea yoki davr.

cards.ex: Humans have told stories since the dawn of time.
cards.exUz: Odamlar zamon boshlanganidan beri hikoyalar aytib kelishadi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixning eng boshlanishi yoki juda qadim zamonlar.

cards.ex: Respect for elders is a deep-seated tradition in many Asian cultures.
cards.exUz: Kattalarni hurmat qilish ko'plab Osiyo madaniyatlarida chuqur ildiz otgan an'anadir.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan va jamiyatga singib ketgan an'ana.

cards.ex: The city is known for its vibrant cultural tapestry, with influences from all over the world.
cards.exUz: Shahar o'zining yorqin madaniy gobeleni bilan tanilgan, unga butun dunyo ta'sir ko'rsatgan.
cards.uzDef: Har xil madaniy unsurlardan tashkil topgan murakkab va boy tuzilma.

cards.ex: We need to build upon the foundations laid by previous generations.
cards.exUz: Biz avvalgi avlodlar tomonidan qo'yilgan poydevorga qurishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi ishlar yoki yutuqlarga asoslanib, rivojlantirmoq.

cards.ex: The photographs evoked memories of a bygone age.
cards.exUz: Suratlar o'tgan davr xotiralarini uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi bir davr, endi mavjud bo'lmagan.

cards.ex: Her diary is a chronicle of her experiences during the war.
cards.exUz: Uning kundaligi urush davridagi tajribalarining xronikasidir.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar yoki tarixiy faktlarning ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: Shakespeare's works have left an enduring legacy on English literature.
cards.exUz: Shekspir asarlari ingliz adabiyotiga bardavom meros qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt sinovidan o'tgan va hali ham ta'sir ko'rsatadigan meros.

cards.ex: The old town still retains vestiges of its colonial past.
cards.exUz: Eski shahar hali ham o'zining mustamlaka o'tmishining izlarini saqlab qolgan.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdan qolgan qoldiqlar yoki belgilar.

cards.ex: The origins of this tradition are lost in the mists of time.
cards.exUz: Ushbu an'ananing kelib chiqishi zamon tumanida yo'qolgan.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq o'tmishda, aniq eslash qiyin bo'lgan paytda.

cards.ex: The country went through a period of great upheaval after the revolution.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat inqilobdan keyin katta to'polon davrini boshidan kechirdi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsizliklar, o'zgarishlar va beqarorlik bilan ajralib turadigan davr.

cards.ex: The region's history is a rich and complex historical tapestry.
cards.exUz: Mintaqaning tarixi boy va murakkab tarixiy gobelendir.
cards.uzDef: Murakkab va o'zaro bog'liq tarixiy voqealar va ta'sirlarning kombinatsiyasi.

cards.ex: New York City is a famous cultural melting pot.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York shahri mashhur madaniy qozondir.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar aralashib, yangi birlikni hosil qiladigan joy.

cards.ex: Maintaining traditions provides a sense of continuity with the past.
cards.exUz: An'analarni saqlash o'tmish bilan uzluksizlik hissini beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish, hozirgi va kelajak o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni his qilish.

cards.ex: The incident is just a historical footnote in the grand scheme of things.
cards.exUz: Bu voqea narsalarning katta rejasida shunchaki tarixiy izohdir.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy voqea emas, balki kichik va ahamiyatsiz voqea.

cards.ex: The media plays a significant role in shaping the narrative around political events.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari siyosiy voqealar atrofidagi hikoyani shakllantirishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar yoki tarix qanday hikoya qilinishini ta'sir qilmoq.

cards.ex: The architecture of the city still carries echoes of the past.
cards.exUz: Shaharning arxitekturasi hali ham o'tmish sadosini olib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi voqealarning hozirgi zamonda seziladigan ta'siri.

cards.ex: Decisions made in the corridors of power can affect millions of people.
cards.exUz: Hokimiyat yo'laklarida qabul qilingan qarorlar millionlab odamlarga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat va siyosiy qarorlar qabul qilinadigan joylarda.

cards.ex: Some works of art continue to stand the test of time.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi san'at asarlari vaqt sinovidan o'tishda davom etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida qadriyatini saqlab qolmoq.

cards.ex: The university has a long and storied history dating back centuries.
cards.exUz: Universitet asrlar oldinga borib taqaladigan boy tarixga ega.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p voqealarga boy, uzoq tarix.

cards.ex: Understanding historical currents is crucial for interpreting the present.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi zamonni talqin qilish uchun tarixiy oqimlarni tushunish juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy voqealarni shakllantiradigan katta tendentsiyalar yoki kuchlar.

cards.ex: Sport can play a role in fostering a sense of collective identity.
cards.exUz: Sport jamoaviy o'zlik hissini shakllantirishda rol o'ynashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir guruh odamlarni birlashtiradigan umumiy his-tuyg'ular va qadriyatlar.

cards.ex: Many of the social reformers were products of their time.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab ijtimoiy islohotchilar o'z davrlarining mahsuli edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z davri sharoitlari va g'oyalari ta'sirida bo'lgan.

cards.ex: The Beatles are a cultural touchstone for many people of that generation.
cards.exUz: The Beatles o'sha avlodning ko'p odamlari uchun madaniy mezontoshdir.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyat uchun muhim va taniqli shaxs, joy yoki voqea.

cards.ex: Her research laid the foundation for future studies in the field.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqotlari sohada kelajakdagi tadqiqotlar uchun poydevor qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakdagi muvaffaqiyat uchun asos yaratmoq.

cards.ex: The two countries are still dealing with the historical baggage of their past conflict.
cards.exUz: Ikki davlat hali ham o'zlarining o'tmishdagi mojarolarining tarixiy yukini hal qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammolar va mojarolar hozirgi munosabatlarga ta'sir qilishi.

cards.ex: You can't turn back the clock; we have to move forward.
cards.exUz: Siz soatni orqaga qaytara olmaysiz; biz oldinga siljishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi holatga qaytishga harakat qilmoq, lekin bu ilojsiz.
